description: This file defines the LoggerInterface interface as specified by PSR-3, outlining the methods that a logger implementation must include for various logging levels and behaviors.

classes.name: LoggerInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for logger classes, including methods for different logging levels such as emergency, alert, critical, error, warning, notice, info, debug, and general log with arbitrary levels.

methods.name: emergency
methods.description: Indicates a system is unusable, requiring immediate attention.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Indicates action must be taken immediately, e.g., website downtime or database failure.

methods.name: critical
methods.description: Represents critical conditions such as application component unavailability.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs runtime errors that do not require immediate action but should be monitored.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Logs exceptional occurrences that are not errors.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs interesting events like user logins or SQL logs.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with an arbitrary level, allowing custom logging levels.
